findings.title: A finished round whose PR norn opened in that round shows 'round done, no PR' until the next sync
findings.repro: Story in a round that opens a PR (quick: work -> open-pr -> ready). Approve `ready` before any sync has seen the new PR (within sync_interval of open-pr). `norn status` shows 'gh-42: quick round done, no PR' / 'or close the issue' / `norn story edit gh-42 --workflow <name>` although PR #100 is open. Expected the 'Merge PR #100' item. After `norn sync` (tick --sync) it shows 'Merge PR #100 (still a draft)'. Seen 2/2 (gh-33 in scenario B, gh-42 in scenario C).
findings.detail: The done case uses knownPr(story), which only knows PRs a sync has fetched; the round's own open-pr is not counted, so the item offers 'close the issue' on a story with an open PR. Before this change the same window showed 'workflow done — waiting for the PR merge'. Evidence: B27-C.md (status before and after tick --sync).

findings.title: `norn status` (markdown) does not show the round number or workflow
findings.repro: Story gh-61 in round 2 (story) at refine. `norn status` (the markdown a person reads) prints 'gh-61  refine is ready (manual): start an agent in the worktree' with no round number or workflow. Expected the round and workflow next to the step, as `story view` ('round 2 · story · ready at refine') and the handoff header ('Round 2 · Workflow: story · Step: refine (attempt 1)') show. Only `status --json` carries round {n, workflow}.
findings.detail: status --json items carry round {n, workflow}, but the markdown renderer prints neither. Slice 10's AC2 tested only status --json; B28 names `norn status`. Evidence: B28.md, B6.md.
